# 02-demand — actuals ledger

Daily and interval actuals for the Halcyon book. Ledger lifecycle: **append**. A re-pull is a new file version, never an overwrite. Every column cites a definition in `01-definitions/` by slug.

**Provenance (phase 0):** all files here are synthetic, generated by `sim/generate.ts` with seed `20260720`. The ground truth is recorded in `sim/GROUND-TRUTH.md`. Regenerate with `bun run sim/generate.ts`. Each CSV has a `.md` header beside it, written by the generator, with row counts and the same citations.

## Files

| File | Grain | Scope | Rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `daily-channel.csv` | day × channel | Meridian, days 1–120 | 360 |
| `interval-30min.csv` | 30-min × channel | Meridian, chat and voice, days 1–120 | 11,520 |
| `daily-cohort.csv` | day × cohort × channel | Meridian, handled and AHT by agent group | 570 |
| `daily-transactions.csv` | day × region | Whole book, all regions, platform tagged | 360 |
| `daily-travelers.csv` | day | Meridian, travelers and ratios | 120 |
| `beacon-daily.csv` | day × region | Beacon: 56 days before day 1 (all regions), then each region while it remains on Beacon | 325 |

## Column → definition

### `daily-channel.csv` and `interval-30min.csv`

| Column | Definition (slug) | Name | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date`, `day`, `dow` | — | | Day 1 = 2026-07-20 (Mon). `interval_start` is planning-org local time, 30-min bins |
| `platform` | — | | Always `Meridian` in this file |
| `channel` | — | | `voice`, `chat`, `email` (email in the daily file only) |
| `offered` | `offered` | Offered contacts | For email: arrivals |
| `handled` | `handled` | Handled contacts | For email = offered (backlog carried, no abandons) |
| `handled_in_sl` | `handled-in-sl` | Handled within service level | Threshold: voice 20 s, chat 180 s, email 7,200 s |
| `abandoned` | `abandoned` | Abandoned contacts | Chat: includes customer-side exits before answer; timeouts after answer are not abandons |
| `asa_sec` | `asa` | Average speed of answer | Email: first-response time in seconds |
| `sl_pct` | `service-level` | Service level | `handled_in_sl ÷ offered × 100` |
| `aht_sec` | `aht-elapsed` | **AHT (elapsed)** | Chat: wall-clock session time including waits up to the 10-minute timeout and time spent on concurrent chats |
| `aht_agent_sec` | `aht-agent-work` | **AHT (agent work)** | Chat: elapsed ÷ effective concurrency (`concurrency`). Voice and email: equal to `aht_sec` |

The definitions index refers to these two columns as `aht_elapsed_s` and `aht_agent_work_s`; in phase 0 the ledgers carry the shorter names `aht_sec` and `aht_agent_sec` with the same meaning. **Do not compare `aht_sec` on chat to any Beacon number or to the plan of record; both of those are agent-work figures.**

Interval rows sum exactly to the daily row for `offered`, `handled`, `handled_in_sl` and `abandoned`. Interval `asa_sec` and AHT are interval means, not sums.

## Reconciliation rules (DataEngineer)

1. `offered = handled + abandoned` on voice and chat; `handled = offered` on email.
2. `handled_in_sl ≤ handled`.
3. Interval sums = daily; cohort sums = daily handled.
4. `daily-travelers.contacts` = sum of `daily-channel.offered` per day.
5. A region appears in `beacon-daily.csv` or in the Meridian files on a given day, never both.
